description: 马移位开列，车闪击得马
explanation_en: Moving the knight uncovers the rook's attack down the d-file, winning the opposing knight.

intro.popup: 💡 闪击：白马在d4，白车在d2，黑马在d5。马走开，能让车闪击d5黑马吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Discovered attack: White's knight is on d4, rook on d2, and Black's knight on d5. Can the knight move to uncover the rook's attack on d5?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Nf3！马离开d4，车d2对准d5黑马——闪击赢马！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Nf3 moves the knight away from d4, uncovering the rook's attack on Black's knight at d5.

moves.popup: 白马Nf3！马离开d4，d列打通：白车d2直接攻击d5黑马！
moves.popup_en: White moves the knight to f3, clearing the d-file so the rook on d2 attacks Black's knight on d5.

moves.popup: 黑车Re3试图反击，但黑马d5已无法兼顾。
moves.popup_en: Black's rook moves to e3 to counterattack, but the knight on d5 remains under threat.

moves.popup: 白车Rxd5！闪击成功——马走开，车得马！
moves.popup_en: White's rook captures on d5. The discovered attack succeeds, and White wins the knight.
